about: The v1 build spec §5: how a peer cohort is built. Read by lib/peers/cohort.ts; nothing here is a figure.

floor.about: §5.2: below either, nothing is served — no number, no rounding, no bucket.

period.about: §5.1: a calendar month. A business counts for a month only with at least min_days days measured in it.

nace.about: NACE Rev. 2, the classification Eurostat SBS still publishes (benchmark-map-v1.json). The finest code known for each business type, written 'dd.dd' (4-digit), 'dd.d' (3-digit) or 'dd' (2-digit); a cohort widens 4 → 3 → 2 by cutting it. A type broader than any 2-digit division is held at its section letter, which is its only level. null: no cohort. Each code is SYB's reading of the type, for the owner to correct.

regions.about: §5.1's region groups, the country's fallback. FR and IT are groups of one: they never widen past themselves. A country in no group widens straight to the revenue band.

revenue_bands.about: §5.1's logarithmic bands, on a year's revenue in euro cents: the measured month × 12, converted at the month's last ECB rate for the band only — no figure is ever converted to compare (D44). 'to' is exclusive; null is open.
